_comment: Per-use-case risk-tolerance/latency-budget profiles. 'internal' is set to exactly match the pre-policy-layer hardcoded constants (decision_engine.BLOCK_Z_SCORE/FLAG_Z_SCORE, detectors.performance.REVIEW_THRESHOLD/SLOW_CHECK_SAMPLE_RATE) so it is a behavior-preserving default. Edit this file to retune a tier without touching Python or redeploying code.

customer_facing._comment: Stricter: lower tolerance for cost anomalies, more slow-check sampling, lower review thresholds. Fits a live, user-facing chatbot where a bad response is seen immediately.

internal._comment: Baseline tier — identical to the original hardcoded defaults. Fits an internal copilot where reviewers are already in the loop.

batch._comment: Most lenient: batch/offline workloads tolerate more cost variance and don't need heavy live sampling, since output is reviewed downstream anyway.
